# Jakub (Kuba) Jerzmanowski

> Jakub (Kuba) Jerzmanowski is an AI/ML engineer and researcher. He builds
> end-to-end machine learning products — spanning data collection, model
> training, and evaluation. Additionally, he designs agentic systems that work
> in the real world. He maintains an active publication record.
> Personal site: https://kubajerzmanowski.com

## Background & Expertise

- **Role:** AI/ML Engineer (full-time)
- **Education:** M.S. in Computer Science
- **Focus Areas:** Training neural networks from scratch; end-to-end ML systems (data collection -> training -> evaluation); design of agentic systems; applied machine learning research
- **Research Interests:** Wearables and sensor data; more recently, neuroimaging models
